analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced problems with enabling the Ethernet connection in the [product_name] software, primarily due to the interface not providing clear feedback or guidance when the Diagram Editor was not active. Confusion also arose about hardware setup and whether a demo version of the software was being used. The main challenge highlighted is a lack of user guidance when essential options are unavailable, making the workflow unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily configure Ethernet settings within the [product_name] software for their devices, without needing to perform non-intuitive steps like changing editor focus. They also anticipate clear instructions in the interface that explain what actions to take when required features are inactive or unavailable.
